message.content:
This editorial illustration features the title "TEMPO" in large red letters across the top, above several illustrated individuals and giant syringes. Six people are depicted in various professional attires, including white lab coats, a surgical mask, and a head mirror. Their skin tones are tan, and their hair colors range from black to dark brown. One man in the foreground holds binoculars, while a woman behind him points upward.

The background is a dark blue, textured surface. Three large, white syringes with blue accents and sharp needles angle upwards from the left and right. The text "TOKOH PILIHAN 2021" is printed above the main title. In the bottom-right corner, black text reads "Para Pemutus Virus," with smaller text below starting with "Mereka di garda terdepan..." and ending with "Covid-19. H.22".

A barcode and QR code are visible in the top-right corner, along with publishing details like "27 DESEMBER 2021 - 2 JANUARI 2022" and "RP 45.000". Small letters "E N A K D I D E N G A R D A N P E R L U" are spaced below the main title.
